text:
maya: FYI PR #991 updates the POST /v1/generate request example to include the new `context` object, but the schema still marks `context` as optional map<string,string>. The PR adds an array of objects instead: "context": [{"k": "env", "v": "prod"}]. cc @kai @ron

kai: Link?

maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/991 - backend will accept both forms at the moment, but we should keep the docs consistent with the canonical OpenAPI shape (object map).

ron: That mismatch will confuse SDK generators and examples. We should not merge until examples + snippets match the spec. If backend supports both, add a note and show both examples (canonical + legacy array).

maya: I agree. Proposal: revert the example to the canonical map form in the main example, add a short "Legacy payloads" sub-example showing the array-of-kv form, and include a tiny migration snippet in Python and TS showing conversion.

kai: For snippets, show both directions: server-side normalization and client helper. TS: `function normalizeContext(ctx: any): Record<string,string> { if (Array.isArray(ctx)) { return Object.fromEntries(ctx.map(({k,v}) => [k,String(v)])); } return ctx; }` Python: `def normalize_context(ctx): if isinstance(ctx, list): return {item['k']: str(item['v']) for item in ctx} return ctx` Keep these as inline code blocks in the notes.

docs-bot: openapi-lint: example/type-mismatch: /paths/~1v1~1generate/post/requestBody/content/application~1json/schema/properties/context expected object but found array in example.

ron: Also add a short SDK note: Ruby/Go SDKs should accept both shapes gracefully; add a test fixture in examples/fixtures/generate-context.json containing both variants to ensure our serializers handle it.

maya: Will update PR: revert main example, add legacy example block labeled "legacy array-of-kv format", add TS/Python normalize snippets, and add fixtures. Also adding a one-line note on the endpoint page about backward compatibility and recommended canonical shape.

kai: Nit: call out that keys/values are strings in the map. Some samples show numbers; we should coerce to string in the normalize helpers. Add `String(v)` or `str(v)` as you suggested.

maya: Good catch. Will do. I'll also drop a line in CHANGELOG under docs: "Clarify generate endpoint context shape and add migration snippets for legacy array-of-kv payloads."

docs-bot: ci/checks: openapi-lint failed (example mismatch) until example updated.

maya: Pushed commit that reverts example to map, adds legacy block + snippets + fixture. Triggering CI now. Ping @kai @ron for quick review.

ron: Reviewing. Small suggestion: in the TS snippet use `Record<string,string>` in signature, and show a one-liner `const normalized = normalizeContext(payload.context)` in example request to be explicit.

kai: LGTM after tiny tweaks.

docs-bot: ci/checks: examples-validate passed. openapi-lint passed.

maya: Merged. Thanks all. Closing thread.
